methods: Missing UAT proved by unique active own P843, compatible municipal class, Romanian label and judet. Copy unique own Earth P625 at eight decimals, strictly inside its code-matched valid 2025 UAT polygon before and after formatting. Boundary used only for checking. Plain official name and identical native, without UAT category prefix; literal own-item translations under the repository enrichment rule, Romanian translation set to that plain name. No population copied.

Parent-only correction: own active P843 or earlier reviewed unchanged-identity binding identifies this same level-3 locality. SIRUTA SIRSUP identifies a unique existing or independently added level-2 UAT; same judet and strict unchanged stored-point containment in its valid code-matched polygon. Unresolved keys require reviewed original v4.0 name, own item, point, state and country continuity; no entity-scope change.
